hero.title: Senior Full-Stack Java Engineer — Payments & Fintech
hero.valueProp: I build and modernize secure, scalable production platforms — deep in payments and fintech, broad across mobility, DevOps, and full-stack delivery.

about.label: About
about.heading: Payments-led, broad by design.
body: I'm a Senior Full-Stack Java Engineer specialized in payments and fintech, with 20+ years of experience — the last decade at Telclic (Dublin; remote from Brazil), building and modernizing production platforms.

Payments is my deepest specialty: I raised card authorization from ~38% to ~85% and integrated 13 gateways behind unified, PCI-aware APIs. But my work spans much more — mobility and smart-city platforms, end-to-end full-stack delivery in Java/Spring and Angular, the team's CI/CD that I built from scratch, and legacy-to-modern migrations.
I work asynchronously across time zones, with near-full daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. Fluent English (C1). I'm looking for remote roles where depth, range, and ownership matter.

telclic.summary: Core full-stack engineer across payment, insurance, mobility, and smart-city platforms. Joined a 3-person team and helped grow it into a mature, multi-country engineering operation.

groups.title: Payments
bullets: Raised authorization from ~38% to ~85% by designing and building two new gateway integrations (Stripe ~95%, Fiserv/Authipay ~90%) and migrating merchant traffic onto them.

Build and maintain PayBrix, an insurance collections platform publicly reporting €150M+ collected. 180,000+ policyholder records and 1M+ automated reminders (536k SMS + 475k email). Zero confirmed double-charges across 313,000+ card transactions; 99.997% merchant webhook delivery across 238,000+ callbacks.

Integrated and unified 13 payment gateways behind common APIs — using each provider's hosted payment page so cardholder data never touches our systems (reduced PCI scope) — with signature-verified webhooks and OAuth2/JWT.

groups.title: Platform & DevOps
bullets: Built the team's CI/CD from scratch — 26 Jenkins pipelines across 19 deployed services/apps; manual 15-min-to-1-hour releases → ~1-minute deploys (median 45s, 96.7% prod build success).
Introduced the team's core toolchain: Jira, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Slack, and Flyway.

Introduced code-quality, security, and observability tooling: SonarQube quality gates in the CI pipeline (catching bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells), Wazuh for threat prevention and detection, and Uptime Kuma for service uptime monitoring.

groups.title: Modernization
bullets: Solo Java 11→17 and Spring 4.3→5.8 platform upgrade in ~1 week (~20 libraries), then HibernateTemplate → Spring Data JPA migration.
Core contributor (#2) replatforming the AngularJS 1.6.5 UI onto Angular 17.
Built greenfield services on the latest stack (Spring Boot 3.5, Angular 20).

groups.title: Mobility & smart-city
bullets: Delivered full-stack features across mobility platforms — a multi-tenant parking system serving two national markets, a national bike-share, and a port traffic-management system.

groups.title: Leadership
bullets: Led a distributed team of 4–6 as tech lead — 2,300+ pull requests reviewed (900+ approved), 500+ merged PRs authored — while staying hands-on. Mentor and primary technical contact for clients.

groups.title: AI-assisted engineering
bullets: Shipped autonomous daily health-check reporting for production payment systems using a headless LLM.

earlier.description: Built a new batch billing system generating broker-turnover files for one of Brazil's largest insurers, and developed internal web systems deployed via Jenkins; Java, Spring, Struts, JSF, AngularJS, JPA (Oracle, DB2).
Gathered requirements and produced technical specs for a new credit-card authorization system; led daily stand-ups, tested deliveries, and produced delivery estimates.
Built and enhanced corporate web applications (Java, Struts, JSF, EJB, Hibernate).
Led a team of 3; built the company's control system.

Built internationalized (I18N) Java web systems rolled out across multiple countries for a global foodservice distributor; migrated legacy systems to the web via SOAP and produced reporting with Jasper and Crystal Reports.
Intranet news portal and sales system.

items.name: PayBrix
items.description: Insurance-collections platform publicly reporting €150M+ collected — recurring payments, automated dunning, omnichannel outreach.

blocks.label: Integration layer
blocks.text: 13 payment gateways behind one internal API; gateway-hosted payment pages keep card data out of our systems (reduced PCI scope).

blocks.label: Authorization turnaround
blocks.text: ~38% → ~85% — built the Stripe (~95%) and Fiserv/Authipay (~90%) integrations solo, migrated merchant traffic, moved the hosted page from iframe to full-page redirect (fewer 3-D Secure challenges).

blocks.label: Scale & automation
blocks.text: 1M+ automated reminders (SMS + email) · 180,000+ policyholder records · automated reconciliation against provider settlement reports.

items.name: Visitor Parking Management — Greenfield Multi-Tenant SaaS
items.description: White-label, self-service parking payments: a driver scans a QR code, pays by card, and their plate lands on the site's ANPR enforcement whitelist — no app, no ticket machine.

blocks.label: Built from a blank repository
blocks.text: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.5, Angular 20 (separate driver-facing and back-office apps), Spring Data JDBC, Flyway, Maven multi-module.

blocks.label: Multi-tenant by construction
blocks.text: One codebase deployed per market with its own branding, currency, payment gateway and database — live in Ireland and the US.

blocks.label: Card data never touches the platform
blocks.text: Payments are delegated to our PCI-scoped payment platform via gateway-hosted pages.

blocks.label: Product depth
blocks.text: Tiered tariffs · rotating discount QR codes · email/SMS expiry reminders · PDF receipts · tax & convenience-fee engine · scheduled GDPR obfuscation of personal data · whitelist push to the external enforcement provider.

blocks.label: Device backbone ahead of hardware
blocks.text: MQTT telemetry layer (Spring Integration over TLS, QoS 2, durable sessions) built and receiving ahead of the barrier/camera rollout, with an API-vs-MQTT abstraction per device.

items.name: TrafficFlow
items.description: Cloud HGV traffic-management platform for the Port of Dakar: ANPR automated entry/exit, scheduling, and integrated payments; relieved congestion that had forced vessels to reroute.

items.name: TFI Bikes
items.description: National public bike-share across four Irish cities, backed by the National Transport Authority: multilingual web and iOS/Android apps.

items.name: 2Bill
items.description: Direct-carrier mobile billing: charges to phone bill, sub-10-second transactions, via operators including Vodafone, Three, and O2.
